summary: Self-generated scalar plane-parallel azimuth-averaged multi-stream discrete-ordinates solution; not an external validated benchmark or field observation.
equation: mu dL/dz = -(a+b)L + b/(4pi) integral[p(mu,mu')L dOmega'] + direct-beam elastic source
boundary: Ed_direct(0-)=1, downward diffuse(0-)=0; lower boundary at 12 optical depths has no upwelling incoming radiance; no Fresnel refraction or surface reflection
geometry: azimuth averaged, mu of propagation positive downward, solar angles in water numerically set equal to input nominal angles (no refraction)

phase.scatteringRelation: b = bb/f_b(HG), discretely normalized angular kernel

grid.angularMeaning: L_u(z,mu) azimuth-averaged at Gauss nodes; values normalized to incident Ed_direct(0-)=1

numerical.warning: not cross-verified against HydroLight or DISORT; numerical convergence check is internal

referenceSources.name: Mobley et al. (1993), Comparison of numerical models for computing underwater light fields
Loisel et al. (2023), synthetic HydroLight ocean optical database; methodology reference only—not copied
